title: ON.energy news and rows
description: A light news section: a big weight-300 heading whose letters blur in, a short intro far below it, two featured stories side by side with large 32px-rounded 3:2 images and a mono kind/date column beside the title and excerpt, then a ruled list of more stories (title, date, read more). Rows fill grey on hover while the title slides right and the link slides left; cards and rows rise in on scroll.
notes: inverted on purpose: bg-foreground with text-background, so it is light on the dark theme and dark on the light one
media slot per featured story: a 3:2 image; empty, a tinted panel stands in
CSS only; off under reduced motion
